::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's largest OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) company and the world's third-largest — founded in 1972, and controlled since November 2024 by China Resources (Holdings), which holds a 22.53% stake through its subsidiary Panshi Runqi and controls a board majority. Not found on the US Entity List in the sources checked for this tracker, despite advanced packaging increasingly being discussed as a future export-control target. H1 2026 non-GAAP net profit grew 84.7% year-on-year as advanced-packaging orders accelerated.
:::

**Chinese name:** 长电科技 (Chángdiàn Kējì)

## What does this facility make?

Chip assembly, test, and advanced packaging services — not a fab, but the step between a finished wafer and a sellable chip. Demonstrated high-volume packaging of 4nm-class chips using chiplet technology.

## Why does it matter?

Advanced packaging (chiplets, heterogeneous integration) is one of the segments China's Big Fund III and its OSAT majors are explicitly pivoting toward, since it offers a path to competitive chip performance without needing export-controlled leading-edge lithography. By 2026 the company says its entire production line has moved upmarket to five top-tier processes: XDFOI multi-dimensional heterogeneous integration, 1.5-micron ultra-fine hybrid bonding, 3D logic folding, HBM (high-bandwidth memory) packaging, and CPO (co-packaged optics).

## Packaging Technology Trajectory

- **2013**: company-wide: Bumping (8-12in), WLCSP, FCBGA/FCLGA flip-chip in volume
- **2016**: Jiangyin (JCET Advanced Packaging): Bumping and WLCSP at global scale
- **2023**: company-wide: XDFOI chiplet (2.5D/3D fan-out) stable volume; 4nm MCM ship

## Project Timeline

- **Aug 2015** — Acquires Singapore's STATS ChipPAC, becoming one of the world's top-three OSAT firms by revenue
- **Jul 2026** — Reports H1 2026 non-GAAP net profit up 84.7% year-on-year, crediting advanced-packaging (chiplet, HBM, CPO) order growth
